entities.summary: Inca, a notable figure in the history of Chile, associated with Inca Expansion and Spanish Conquest (1470–1536). Preceded by Inca Empire and Chile becomes southern frontier of Tawantinsuyu. Their legacy influenced Inca expansion halted by Mapuche at the Battle of the Maule c. 1485 and Santiago founded by Pedro de Valdivia — February 12, 1541.
